events.text:
Hi Sam!

Great question! For your Black Fig candle, we recommend letting it burn for about 2 to 3 hours during the first burn—or until the top layer of wax is completely melted all the way to the edges of the jar. This creates a proper "melt pool" and prevents tunneling for all future burns.

Enjoy your candle, and let us know if you need anything else!

Best,
Maple & Moss Candle Co.
